missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Тип' is the nominative predicate noun. 'Новый' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'совершенно' intensifies the newness.

Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Тип' is the accusative object of 'открыли'; this inanimate masculine noun is identical in the nominative and accusative. 'Клеток' is the genitive plural, showing of what.
Strategic focus: Genitive in a possession frame. 'Типа' is the genitive form after 'у' showing whose advantages. 'Преимущества' is the nominative plural subject of 'есть'.

missions.phrase: Этот мотор подходит к новому типу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Типу' is the dative form required by 'к' to express suitability. 'Новому' agrees in the masculine dative, and 'мотор' is the nominative subject.

missions.phrase: Этот прибор работает совсем другим типом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner. 'Типом' is in the instrumental case expressing the way it works. 'Другим' agrees in the masculine instrumental, reinforced by 'совсем'.

missions.phrase: В статье рассказано об этом типе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional after об. 'Об типе' uses the prepositional 'типе' to name the topic. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional, and 'в статье' is also prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Типы' is the nominative plural subject of 'существуют'. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, and 'характеров' is the genitive plural, showing of what.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Типы' is the accusative plural object of 'изучаем'; as an inanimate noun it matches the nominative plural. 'Эти' agrees, and 'данных' is genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after несколько. 'Типов' is the genitive plural form required by 'несколько'. 'Почвы' is genitive, and 'существует' is the impersonal verb.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Тип' is the nominative subject. 'Двигателя' is genitive, specifying which type, and 'надёжный' is the agreeing masculine predicate adjective.
